title: 马来西亚道教理事总会贺信
title_en: Malaysian Taoist General Council Congratulatory Letter
body: 马来西亚道教理事总会致函祝贺，期望加强两国道教组织间的友好合作关系。
body_en: The Malaysian Taoist General Council sent congratulations, hoping to strengthen friendly cooperation between Taoist organizations in both countries.
